rows.text_en: Ministry of Gender Equality and Family ( Operations Support Division ), 02-2100-6047

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「비상대비에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항 중 성평등가족부장관의 소관 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2025. 9. 30., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Emergency Preparedness and its Enforcement Decree, as well as matters necessary for their implementation that fall under the jurisdiction of the Minister of Gender Equality and Family. <Amended Sep. 30, 2025; Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(관리대상업체의 범위) 「비상대비에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제2조제2호에 따른 물적자원 중 성평등가족부장관이 관리하는 관리대상업체는 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2025. 9. 30., 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Scope of Businesses Subject to Management) Among the material resources under Article 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Act on Emergency Preparedness (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the businesses subject to management managed by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family are as follows: <Amended Sep. 30, 2025; Oct. 1, 2025>
1. Korea Institute for Healthy Families pursuant to Article 34-2 of the Framework Act on Healthy Families

rows.source_ko: 2. 「양성평등기본법」 제46조에 따른 한국양성평등교육진흥원 및 같은 법 제46조의2에 따른 한국여성인권진흥원
rows.text_en: 2. The Korea Institute for Gender Equality Education pursuant to Article 46 of the Framework Act on Gender Equality and the Korea Women's Human Rights Promotion Institute pursuant to Article 46-2 of the same Act
3. Korea Youth Counseling and Welfare Development Institute pursuant to Article 22 of the Youth Welfare Support Act
4. Korea Youth Activities Promotion Agency pursuant to Article 6 of the Youth Activities Promotion Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 비상시 여성ㆍ가족ㆍ청소년의 보호 및 지원을 위하여 필요하다고 성평등가족부장관이 인정하는 기관 또는 단체
rows.text_en: 5. Other institutions or organizations recognized by the Minister of Gender Equality and Family as necessary for the protection and support of women, families, and youth in times of emergency

rows.source_ko: 제3조(자원조사) 법 제10조 및 「비상대비에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제9조에 따른 자원조사는 매년 12월 31일을 기준으로 하여 연 1회 실시한다. <개정 2025. 9. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Resource Survey) The resource survey pursuant to Article 10 of the Act and Article 9 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Emergency Preparedness (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be conducted once a year as of December 31 of each year. <Amended Sep. 30, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(중점관리대상업체 지정 및 임무고지서의 발급 등) 성평등가족부장관은 법 제11조 및 영 제10조에 따라 중점관리대상업체를 지정하였을 때에는 별지 제1호서식의 중점관리대상업체 지정 및 임무고지서를 지체 없이 중점관리대상업체의 장에게 보내고, 별지 제2호서식의 중점관리대상업체 지정대장에 이를 기록ㆍ관리하여야 한다. 중점관리대상업체의 지정을 변경하는 경우에도 또한 같다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Designation of Priority Management Enterprises and Issuance of Notice of Duties, etc.) When the Minister of Gender Equality and Family designates a priority management enterprise pursuant to Article 11 of the Act and Article 10 of the Enforcement Decree, the Minister shall send the Notice of Designation and Duties of Priority Management Enterprises (Form No. 1) to the head of the priority management enterprise without delay, and shall record and manage it in the Register of Designated Priority Management Enterprises (Form No. 2). The same shall apply in cases where the designation of a priority management enterprise is changed. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2  through 5 omitted

rows.text_en: Article 6 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through ⑪ Omitted

rows.source_ko: ⑫ 여성가족부 소관 비상대비에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: 12 The Enforcement Rules of the Act on Emergency Preparedness under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제명 “「여성가족부 소관 비상대비자원 관리법 시행규칙」”을 “「성평등가족부 소관 비상대비자원 관리법 시행규칙」”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: The title “「Enforcement Rule of the Emergency Preparedness Resource Management Act under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family」” shall be changed to “「Enforcement Rule of the Emergency Preparedness Resource Management Act under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family」”.

rows.source_ko: 제1조, 제2조 각 호 외의 부분, 같은 조 제5호, 제4조 전단 및 별지 제1호서식 중 “여성가족부장관”을 각각 “성평등가족부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 1, the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 2, subparagraph 5 of the same article, the first part of Article 4, and Form No. 1 of the Appendix, “Minister of Gender Equality and Family” shall be changed to “Minister of Gender Equality and Family”.
